from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech
from speech_client import SpeechClientWrapper

def diarized_transcript(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client_wrapper = SpeechClientWrapper()
    client = client_wrapper.get_client()

    audio_uri = payload["audio_uri"]
    language_code = payload["language_code"]
    speaker_count = payload.get("speaker_count", 2) # Default to 2 speakers

    recognition_config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        language_code=language_code,
        enable_speaker_diarization=True,
        diarization_speaker_count=speaker_count,
        model="default", # Use default model for diarization
    )

    audio = speech.RecognitionAudio(uri=audio_uri)

    operation = client.long_running_recognize(config=recognition_config, audio=audio)

    return {
        "job_id": operation.operation.name,
        "status": "SUBMITTED",
    }

from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech
from speech_client import SpeechClientWrapper

def timestamped_transcript(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client_wrapper = SpeechClientWrapper()
    client = client_wrapper.get_client()

    audio_uri = payload["audio_uri"]
    language_code = payload["language_code"]

    recognition_config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        language_code=language_code,
        enable_word_time_offsets=True,
    )

    audio = speech.RecognitionAudio(uri=audio_uri)

    operation = client.long_running_recognize(config=recognition_config, audio=audio)

    return {
        "job_id": operation.operation.name,
        "status": "SUBMITTED",
    }

from google.cloud import language_v1

def moderate_transcript(text):
    client = language_v1.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language_v1.Document(content=text, type_=language_v1.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    sentiment = client.analyze_sentiment(request={'document': document}).document_sentiment

    # A simple moderation: flag if sentiment is very negative
    is_flagged = sentiment.score < -0.5 and sentiment.magnitude > 1.0

    return {
        "sentiment_score": sentiment.score,
        "sentiment_magnitude": sentiment.magnitude,
        "is_flagged_for_moderation": is_flagged,
        "moderation_reason": "Negative sentiment detected" if is_flagged else None,
    }

from google.cloud import aiplatform

def archive_summary(text, project_id, location="us-central1"):
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    
    # Using a text-bison model for summarization
    # Model ID: "text-bison@001" or similar
    # Note: Specific model versions might change, this is an example.
    parameters = {
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_output_tokens": 256,
        "top_p": 0.95,
        "top_k": 40,
    }
    
    model = aiplatform.TextGenerationModel.from_pretrained("text-bison")

    prompt = f"Summarize the following transcript:

{text}

Summary:"

    response = model.predict(prompt, **parameters)

    return {"summary": response.text}

from google.cloud import aiplatform

def transcript_embedding(text, project_id, location="us-central1"):
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)

    # Using a text-embedding-gecko model for embeddings
    # Model ID: "text-embedding-gecko@001" or similar
    # Note: Specific model versions might change, this is an example.
    model = aiplatform.TextEmbeddingModel.from_pretrained("text-embedding-gecko")
    embeddings = model.get_embeddings([text])

    return {"embedding": embeddings[0].values}
